What you can expect

Handled with care from cold store to kitchen

  • Own cold storage

    Products are held in our own cold storage facilities with maintained temperatures before dispatch.

  • Expiry checked at dispatch

    Every order is checked for shelf life before it leaves us, so expired stock never reaches your kitchen.

  • Veg & non-veg kept separate

    Vegetarian and non-vegetarian products are stored and handled separately.

  • Delhi NCR base, pan-India supply

    Serving kitchens across Delhi NCR, with supply to customers across India.

  • Dedicated customer care

    A responsive team for orders, availability questions and after-sales support.

  • One supplier, many categories

    Seafood, Japanese & Asian pantry, cheese, chicken and lamb from a single point of contact.

Getting started

Opening a supply account

  1. Share your menu needs

    Products, cuts, pack sizes and approximate weekly or monthly volumes.

  2. Samples & quotation

    We confirm availability and share a quotation. Ask our team about samples for evaluation.

  3. Agree terms

    Delivery schedule, ordering process and payment terms agreed with your purchase team.

  4. Regular supply

    Order by phone, WhatsApp or email; every dispatch is shelf-life checked.

Questions from purchase teams

Do you supply outside Delhi NCR?

Yes. We are based in New Delhi and supply customers across India. Delivery method and timelines depend on your location and order — our team will confirm them with your quotation.

Are you FSSAI licensed and GST registered?

Yes. We hold FSSAI Central Licence No. 13325999000401 and GSTIN 07AALCD3845N1Z4. Copies can be shared for vendor onboarding on request.

Do you publish prices?

No. Prices depend on product, pack size, volume and shipment, so we quote per account. Request a quote and we will respond with current pricing.

How do you store products before dispatch?

Products are held in our own cold storage facilities with maintained temperatures. Vegetarian and non-vegetarian products are stored separately, and every order is checked for shelf life before dispatch.

Can I order seafood, Japanese pantry and cheese together?

Yes — consolidating categories into a single order is one of the main reasons kitchens work with us.

Planning your next menu or monthly purchase?

Share your requirements and our team will respond with availability and a quotation.
